title_en: Commentary on al-Jazariyyah — The Last Tape
body_ar:
سأعيد متن الباب السابق لتصحيح الأخطاء التي فيه، قال المؤلف رحمه الله:

واعْرِفْ لمقطوع وموصول وتا** في مصحف الإمام فيما قد أتى

فاقطع بعشر كلمات ألا** معْ مَلْجَإٍ ولا إله إلا

وتعبدوا يَاسِينَ ثاني هودَ لا** يشركن تشركْ يدخُلَنْ تعلوا على

ألَّا يقولوا لا أقولٍَ إما** بالرعد والمفتوح صل وعما

نهوا اقطعوا مما بروم والنسا** خلف المنافقين أمَّن أسسا

فصلت النسا وذبح حيثما** وأن لم المفتوح كسر إنما

الانعام والمفتوح يدعون معا** وخلف الانفال ونحل وقعا

وكل ما سألتموه واختلف** ردوا كذا قل بيسما والوصل صف

خلفتموني واشتروا في ما اقطعا** أوحي أفضتم اشتهت يبلو معا

ثاني فعلن وقعد روم كلا** تنزيل ظلة وغيرها صلا

فأينما كالنحل صل ومختلف** في الشعرا الأحزاب والنسا وصف

وصل فإلم هود أن لن نجعلا** نجمع كي لا تحزنوا تأسوا على

حج عليك حرج وقطعهم** عن من يشاء من تولى يومهم

ومال هذا والذين هؤلا** تحين في الإمام صل ووهلا

ووزنوهم وكالوهم صل** كذا من ال وها ويا لا تفصل
body_en:
I shall repeat the text of the previous chapter in order to correct the errors in it. The author (may God have mercy on him) said:

*And know what is written separated (maqṭūʿ) and what is written joined (mawṣūl), and the written tāʾ, in the muṣḥaf of the Imam, in what has come down in it.*

*So write separately in ten words: an lā — together with maljaʾin, and lā ilāha illā,*

*and taʿbudū [in] Yā Sīn, the second [instance in] Hūd; lā yushrikna, tushrik, yadkhulanna, taʿlū ʿalā,*

*allā yaqūlū, lā aqūla, immā — in al-Raʿd; and the one with the fatḥah, write joined; and ʿammā*

*nuhū: write [these] separately. mimmā in al-Rūm and al-Nisāʾ, with a difference of opinion in al-Munāfiqūn; am man assasa,*

*Fuṣṣilat, al-Nisāʾ and al-Dhabḥ, ḥaythumā; and an lam with the fatḥah; the kasrah of innamā*

*in al-Anʿām; and the one with the fatḥah, yadʿūna, both [instances]; and a difference of opinion has occurred in al-Anfāl and al-Naḥl;*

*and every kulla mā; saʾaltumūhu, and there is disagreement over it; raddū; likewise qul biʾsamā; and set out the cases of writing joined:*

*khalaftumūnī and ishtarū; in fī mā write separately; awḥiya, afaḍtum, ishtahat, yablū, both [instances],*

*the second faʿalna, and waqaʿa [in] al-Rūm, kullā; Tanzīl, [al-]Ẓullah — and write the rest of them joined.*

*fa-aynamā, as in al-Naḥl, write joined; and it differs in al-Shuʿarāʾ, al-Aḥzāb and al-Nisāʾ — so set that out.*

*And write joined fa-illam [in] Hūd, an lan najʿala, najmaʿa, kay lā taḥzanū, taʾsaw, ʿalā*

*Ḥajj, ʿalayka ḥaraj; and their writing separately of ʿan man yashāʾu, man tawallā, yawmahum*

*and mā li-hādhā, wa-lladhīna hāʾulāʾ, taḥīna — in the [muṣḥaf of the] Imam write joined; and wahala*

*and wazanūhum and kālūhum — write joined; likewise min al-, and hā and yā: do not separate them.*

flags.note: CRITICAL. These lines are a technical mnemonic listing which Qur'anic words are written as two words and which as one in the Uthmanic codex. The words are being NAMED, not used, so they are given here as transliterated citation-forms; translating them into English would destroy the content, which is entirely about Arabic spelling. But the line-by-line referents (which sura, which of two instances, where a difference of opinion falls) cannot be fixed from this excerpt alone: the commentary that resolves them is in the downloadable document, not on the page. Several readings here are provisional, in particular 'وقعد روم كلا' and 'ووهلا'. This verse should not be published in English until a qualified reviewer has checked it against a critical edition of al-Jazariyyah and against the tape.

flags.arabic: لا أقولٍَ / الانعام / الانفال / قل بيسما / وقعد روم كلا / ووهلا
options: Leave the readings as the source gives them and flag
Correct silently against a printed edition
flags.note: The stored verse carries apparent textual defects: أقولٍَ bears two incompatible vowel marks; الانعام and الانفال are missing their hamzah; بيسما stands for بئسما; and وقعد روم كلا and ووهلا do not parse cleanly. These have not been corrected, per house rule 11. Note that the Sheikh's own opening sentence says he is repeating the chapter precisely in order to correct errors in it, so the state of this text is doubly significant.

translator_notes: The CMS does not expose a category or section for this record on the article view, and the 2010 archive is not reachable through the site's section listings. section/category_ar/category_en are therefore left null rather than inferred.

The published page carries only the opening excerpt of this tape; the Arabic breaks off and the full text is offered on the site as a downloadable Word document. The English ends exactly where the Arabic ends. Nothing has been supplied to complete it.

This page is almost entirely the base text (matn) of al-Jazariyyah recited by the Sheikh, with a single introductory sentence of his own. His commentary on these lines is not on the page; it is in the downloadable document. The record must therefore not be rendered as though the Sheikh's explanation were present.

The lines are verse (naẓm). They are rendered as prose in italics per house style; no attempt has been made at rhymed English. The Arabic should be displayed alongside, since the subject matter is the Arabic orthography itself.
'The muṣḥaf of the Imam' means the Uthmanic codex, the master copy from which the standard written Qur'an descends.
The double asterisk ** in the Arabic is the source's hemistich divider within each line of verse, not an editorial mark.

al-Jazariyyah is the versified primer on Qur'anic recitation by Ibn al-Jazari, and 'the author' throughout this series is Ibn al-Jazari. The series title is left transliterated and untranslated. Articles 436-446 are tapes of this one series; their tape numbering in the titles does not run in the same order as the article IDs.
